_what: The NAV-REGION PIPELINE'S OTHER HALF. Wave 1 translated llm_map_build_regions, the pipeline's entry point, and translating it is what made the hole visible: `merge_small_regions`, `region_pick_smaller` and `region_split` are verified sim rows, while the five functions build_regions actually calls to do the work are in NO migration ledger at all. They surfaced as `mh::call::` sites with NO OWNING ITEM under gen_va_census's ratchet -- which is the instrument working, not failing: a VA site with no owner is exactly the finding it exists to produce.
_why_translate_rather_than_route: The conductor's 2026-09-10 resolution, under the user's standing ruling that fixpoint-surfaced
sim game logic gets TRANSLATED rather than ratchet-washed. These are pathfinding -- flood fill,
obstacle proximity, multi-resolution seeding, the merge threshold and the route step deltas. They
are the deterministic spine by any reading of docs/reimpl-plan.md Sect. 5, so routing them
through the host API would have put pathfinding behind an inbound call, and raising the VA
ratchet would have recorded a permanent debt for work that is 2692 bytes.
THE RATCHET IS NOT TOUCHED. The VA surface falls back out on its own as each of these stops
being an outward call: wave 1's five MH_LIBMH_BIND declared_needs dissolve into direct sibling
calls once the callee is ours.
